content:
Describes the retry policy in case of function's execution failure. Retried execution is charged as any
other execution.
Enums
RETRY_POLICY_UNSPECIF
IED
Not specified.
RETRY_POLICY_DO_NOT_R
ETRY
Do not retry.
RETRY_POLICY_RETRY
Retry on any failure, retry up to 7 days with an exponential backoff (capped at 10
seconds).
